messages:
incident-bot: SEV-2 alert: hosted-api queue length climbing rapidly for region us-west-2. p95 latency > 6s, p99 > 20s, error rate rising. PagerDuty: PDINC-9982. Auto-escalation to oncall.
Maria G.: grabbing it. seeing large traffic spike from a handful of customers + many small bursts. queues in front of gpu-pool-1 at 18k requests.
Steph (oncall): acked. what's the current autoscaler status? is it launching more nodes or backing off?
EngRuntime Bot: autoscaler: launch_requests=42, successful_provisions=2, provider_errors=40 (429 quota/limit). backoff in effect (exponential). queue_growth_rate=+1.8k/min.
Raj K.: looks like cloud quota is the blocker - provider returned RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED on batch create. autoscaler retries but hits API rate limits. new instance quotas were exhausted for this account.
Kevin S.: confirmed from infra console: instance-quota for GPUs at account level hit. Dedicated pools unaffected. We have spare capacity in dedicated-rtg-2 and private-tenant pools.
Maria G.: immediate mitigation options: 1) temporary global rate-limiting for low-tier keys, 2) failover routing to dedicated pools for flagged customers, 3) ask infra to request quota raise (slow).
Steph (oncall): prioritize options 1+2. can someone flip a soft rate limit while we sort routing?
Raj K.: applying conservative rate limits now. command:
```
POST /admin/ratelimits
{
  "scope": "hosted:low-tier",
  "rate": "30req/s",
  "duration": "15m"
}
```
Raj K.: rate-limit pushed. expecting 40-50% drop in incoming bursts from low-tier traffic in next 2m.
Support Lead: tagging affected customers with temporary banner. creating support broadcast to top 5 spike sources.
Sara (sales): which customer ids? I got pings from a partner complaining about 503s.
Maria G.: top offenders (partial): cust_1872, cust_9124, cust_44 (partner). I'm drafting an incident note for support with ETA.
EngRuntime Bot: routing policy change queued: fallback to dedicated pools for requests with header `x-customer-tier: premium` or `x-reroute=true`.
Kevin S.: manual reroute script ready. executing test on small subset to validate KV-cache correctness.
Steph (oncall): run canary to avoid state mismatch.
Raj K.: Can confirm canary to dedicated-rtg-2 succeeded for 200 reqs. latency stable, no KV-cache mismatch observed.
Raj K.: initiating bulk reroute for premium customers now. script:
```
for id in cust_list: set route[id] = dedicated-rtg-2
```
Maria G.: kicked off infra support ticket to cloud provider for quota raise (inc-req-554). ETA unknown but we asked for immediate increase.
Support Lead: prepped customer messaging. sending to partner cust_44 now: short note + mitigation. :email:
Sara (sales): thanks. get me the list so I can follow up with partner SRE.
Steph (oncall): metrics after 8m since mitigation: queue length dropped from 18k -> 6.2k. p95 down from 6s -> 1.6s for rerouted customers. global p95 still ~3.4s because low-tier still queued.
Maria G.: follow-up action: keep rate limiting in place for another 30m, continue reroute for premium until autoscaler fully recovers or quota raised.
Kevin S.: note: autoscaler logs show long provisioning timeouts when provider returns 429; we should abort slower provisioning attempts to free the controller for smaller requested batches.
Raj K.: added an autoscaler patch to abort after 2m per request and try smaller batch sizes. deploying to canary now.
EngRuntime Bot: deploy started: autoscaler-patch v1.3.2-canary -> env: us-west-2-canary
Steph (oncall): handoff plan: I'm staying on until queue < 500 and p99 < 5s. leaving at 2300 UTC. Maria will take after.
Maria G.: taking handoff at 2300. summary: cause=cloud GPU quota + autoscaler retry/backoff leading to provision stall -> queue growth -> user-facing 5xx/timeouts. mitigations applied: soft rate-limits, premium reroute to dedicated, autoscaler abort patch deployed to canary, infra ticket with provider.
Support Lead: customers notified: cust_44 acknowledged. internal note created: LINK: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-9982
Raj K.: continuing to track blocked provisioning metrics. if quota not lifted in 30m, we should increase reroute scope to mid-tier customers and consider temporary expansion of dedicated pools (commercial decision).
Sara (sales): I'll coordinate with ops to get a temporary dedicated allocation approval if needed.
Steph (oncall): quick status ping before handoff: p95=1.2s (premium), p95 global=1.9s, queue=1.1k, provisioning_errors falling to single digits. good progress.
Kevin S.: recommend postmortem to cover: autoscaler backoff strategy, quota-awareness in provisioning, circuit-breaker for create-instance errors.
Maria G.: acknowledged. will draft postmortem with timeline and suggested action items.
Support Lead: logging final customer impact: #customers impacted: ~120 (degraded), #major customers: 3 (partial outages), primary symptom: 503/timeout. included in incident note.
Steph (oncall): handing off. leaving running checklist in incident doc. next oncall: Maria G.
Maria G.: thanks, taking over. if anything spikes, ping @Maria G. and @Kevin S. direct.
incident-bot: Incident MEDS-1979 closed to active responders. Monitoring-only window started. Please update incident ticket with final notes and ETA for postmortem.
